name: poolA_kbonus_background_dwarfs_v1
target_list_rule: KBONUS-BKG v1.0 source catalogue; background extraction (kic != tpforg); not in Kuber Mehta's 1,800 searched sources; psffrac > 0.5, crowdsap > 0.7, >= 8 PSF quarters, G < 17.5; Gaia DR3 (CDS XMatch, 1 arcsec) dwarf by M_G vs BP-RP (|dMS| band -1.5..+2.0, parallax SNR > 5) or GSP-Phot logg > 4 when parallax poor; own KIC never a Kepler target (NASA Exoplanet Archive keplerstellar, any observed quarter). Ranked by expected SNR of a 2 R_earth, 10-day planet.
null_calibration: The identical screen is applied to the inverted light curve (2 - f) of every star. The first-screen pass rate on inverted data is the empirical false-alarm rate; thresholds above are FIXED before the run and will not be changed after inspecting results. Any tighter post-hoc cut must be reported as post-hoc.
positive_controls: kic-005689121 (Kuber's 13.769 d candidate; expect P=13.769, depth ~1.4-2.4 ppt)
kic-007603200 (Kepler-138; expect c at 13.781 d ~ 700 ppm and d at 23.09 d)
after_first_screen: Survivors go to: catalogue/ephemeris match (KOI, DR25 TCE, Kepler EB, confirmed planets; same period or 1:2, 2:1, 1:3, 3:1 within 0.1% against anything within 3 arcmin AND against the originating TPF star), TLS refinement, per-year depth consistency, pixel-level localisation on the originating TPF, Gaia neighbour/RUWE check, TRICERATOPS. Nothing is called a planet; survivors are 'first-screen signals', then 'candidates' only after pixel-level localisation and ephemeris clearance.
